comments.author: Jean
comments.body:
Lima development lvl has dropped because players are no longer making investment / deliveries and therefore the dungeon is not open if you sail there
however, (someone correct me if im wrong)as i understand it if you find a player whose last dungeon was Lima and use ESBT then you can access the dungeon that way

comments.author: Erda
comments.body: Lima is fine on the investment front it is fully developed there and in no danger of dropping. what it does need though is regular deliveries. all three need to be kept above 40k or it will undevelop. right now trade is close to falling back under 40k and unless some deliveries are made Lima may undevelop again next week

comments.author: Emma
comments.body: The dungeon has been in since they put in Syracuse and Bordeaux dungeons, the only thing that goes away is the entrance to the church. So yes esbt's will still take you to the last dungeon you were in, even if there is no way to walk to it.
